description: This file defines classes and functions for traversing and serializing HTML/XML DOM trees, including a TreeWalker base class and a NonRecursiveTreeWalker subclass, with methods for handling different node types and generating token streams.

classes.name: TreeWalker
classes.description: Base class for traversing DOM trees, providing methods for handling different node types and generating serialized representations.

classes.name: NonRecursiveTreeWalker
classes.description: Subclass of TreeWalker that implements non-recursive tree traversal with methods to access node details and navigate the tree.

methods.name: to_text
methods.description: Converts input to text type, handling None values based on parameter.

methods.name: is_text_or_none
methods.description: Checks if a string is None or of string type.
